# API schemas

## templatedto



- `key` (required) — string. The key of the template Example: `"cloud_manual_work_item_summary"`
- `name` — string. The name of the Task Manager Subscription Example: `"Task Manager Subscription"`
- `medium` (required) — string. The message medium. More mediums may be added in the future. One of: EMAIL, SLACK, TEAMS. Example: `"EMAIL"`
- `locale` (required) — string. The locale for the message text, a BCP 47 language tag. Example: `"en"`
- `subject` — string. The subject line in the template Example: `"You have $numberOfPendingTasks $taskTasks to complete in ${__global.productName}."`
- `header` — string. The header value is now located within the body field. If included with non-null values, will result in a 400.
- `body` — string. The body in the template Example: `"Please go to the task manager"`
- `footer` — string. The footer value is now located within the body field. If included with non-null values, will result in a 400.
- `from` — string. The "From:" address in the template Example: `"$__global.emailFromAddress"`
- `replyTo` — string. The "Reply To" line in the template Example: `"$__global.emailFromAddress"`
- `description` — string. The description in the template Example: `"Daily digest - sent if number of outstanding tasks for task owner > 0"`
- `id` — string. This is auto-generated. Example: `"c17bea3a-574d-453c-9e04-4365fbf5af0b"`
- `created` — string. The time when this template is created. This is auto-generated. Example: `"2020-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z"`
- `modified` — string. The time when this template was last modified. This is auto-generated. Example: `"2020-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z"`
- `slackTemplate` — object. 
- `teamsTemplate` — object. 

## templatevariablesdto

Variables available for use in a notification template. Variables can be template-specific (from domain events) or global (available to all templates like __recipient, __global, __util).

- `key` — string. The notification template key. Example: `"approval_request_notification"`
- `medium` — templatemediumdto. The notification delivery medium. One of: EMAIL, SLACK, TEAMS. Example: `"EMAIL"`
- `globalVariables` — array of templatevariable. Global variables available to all templates for this tenant (e.g. __global.*, __recipient, __util.*, __dateTool.*, __esc.*). Includes both data variables and function-type helpers. Example: `[{"key": "__global.productName", "type": "string", "description": "The human-readable name of the product or application.", "example": "SailPoint Identity Secur`
- `templateVariables` — array of templatevariable. Template-specific variables for the given key and medium (e.g. approverPath, requester, attributes). Example: `[{"key": "approvalName", "type": "string", "description": "Display name of the approval request", "example": "Request for Access to Sales Application"}, {"key":`

## templatevariable

A variable available for use in a notification template. Variables can be template-specific (from domain events) or global (available to all templates like __recipient, __global, __util). Template variables provide self-documenting metadata about what variables are available when customizing notification templates.

- `key` — string. The variable name as used when rendering context in templates. Example: `"recipientDisplayName"`
- `type` — string. The data type for this variable. Use JSON Schema-like names for values (string, boolean, number, object, array) or "function" for template utility/helper functions (e.g. __dateTool.format(), __esc.html()). One of: string, boolean, number, object, array, function. Example: `"string"`
- `description` — string. Human-readable description explaining what this variable represents. Example: `"Display name of the notification recipient"`
- `example` — object. Example value demonstrating the format and usage. For type "function", often a Velocity-style call (e.g. $__esc.html($value)). Can be a string, number, boolean, object, array, or null when no example is defined. Example: `"John Doe"`

## preferencesdto

Tenant notification preferences for a notification key, including preferred mediums and optional CC/BCC email recipients.

- `key` — string. The template notification key. Example: `"cloud_manual_work_item_summary"`
- `mediums` — array of medium. List of preferred notification mediums, i.e., the mediums (or method) for which notifications are enabled. An empty list means the notification is disabled for the tenant. More mediums may be added in the future. Example: `["EMAIL"]`
- `modified` — string. Modified date of preference. Example: `"2020-05-15T14:37:06.909Z"`
- `ccList` — array of ccbccpreferenceentry. Optional CC recipients for email notifications for this key. Requires EMAIL to be included in `mediums`. Maximum of five entries. The same recipient cannot appear in both `ccList` and `bccList`. Example: `[{"type": "IDENTITY", "id": "6b0b8e47cc1f4c3fa961a38fc718e989"}, {"type": "STATIC_EMAIL", "email": "cc-recipient@example.com"}]`
- `bccList` — array of ccbccpreferenceentry. Optional BCC recipients for email notifications for this key. Requires EMAIL to be included in `mediums`. Maximum of five entries. The same recipient cannot appear in both `ccList` and `bccList`. Example: `[{"type": "MANAGER_OF"}, {"type": "ORG_ADMINS"}]`

## sendtestnotificationrequestdto



- `key` — string. The template notification key. Example: `"cloud_manual_work_item_summary"`
- `medium` — string. The notification medium. Has to be one of the following enum values. One of: EMAIL, SLACK, TEAMS. Example: `"EMAIL"`
- `locale` — string. The locale for the message text. Example: `"en"`
- `context` — object. A Json object that denotes the context specific to the template. Example: `{"numberOfPendingTasks": "4", "taskTasks": "tasks"}`
- `recipientEmailList` — array of string. A list of override recipient email addresses for the test notification. Example: `["test@example.com"]`
- `carbonCopy` — array of string. A list of CC email addresses for the test notification. Example: `["cc@example.com"]`
- `blindCarbonCopy` — array of string. A list of BCC email addresses for the test notification. Example: `["bcc@example.com"]`
